# KZ Castor DSP

> A zero-latency Linux DSP daemon engineered in Rust. Featuring hardware-accelerated Woodworth HRTF, real-time head tracking, and zero allocation architecture for the KZ Castor IEMs.

## Quick Facts
- **Latency:** 0.05ms Added Latency (PipeWire Quantum: 256 samples / 5.3ms)
- **Head Tracking:** 30 FPS Head Tracking via OpenCV and MediaPipe.
- **Allocations:** 0 Bytes allocated on the real-time DSP audio path.
- **HRTF:** Woodworth Spherical-Head Model with Freeverb FDN room simulation.

## System Architecture
IEM-DSPD is a headless background daemon written in pure Rust. It hooks directly into the PipeWire audio server.
All DSP operations (10-band PEQ, crossfeed, HRTF convolution, Reverb) are executed in a lock-free, zero-allocation real-time thread.
Configuration updates are passed via Unix Domain Sockets and swapped atomically, ensuring zero dropouts.
